subject: Fall Disability Fair Planning and Website Updates
overview: The commission discussed logistical planning for a fall Disability Fair, including potential dates and engagement strategies, and conducted a detailed review of accessibility resources for the city website.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the April minutes with a correction to the year in the document heading.

items.title: Secretary Position
items.summary: Deferred the appointment of a permanent secretary as no members volunteered, with Gabby agreeing to take notes in the interim.

items.title: Disability Fair Logistics
items.summary: Discussed selecting a fall date for the event at the McGlynn school, focusing on avoiding conflicts with city events, religious holidays, and school facility bookings.

items.title: Medford Housing Authority Resident Engagement
items.summary: Clarified that federal housing matters fall outside the commission's jurisdiction and discussed directing resident complaints to the Department of Housing and Urban Development.

items.title: Correspondence and Informational Updates
items.summary: Received updates regarding a Massachusetts court case on IEP recording, federal Social Security changes, and an upcoming award for upgrades to the West Medford Commuter Rail Station.

items.title: Commission Term Expirations
items.summary: Reminded members whose terms expire in June to notify the Director of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion regarding their intent to continue.

items.title: Website Resource Revisions
items.summary: Reviewed a draft reorganization of the commission's website to include accordions for services and informational resources while auditing existing links for accuracy and relevance.

items.title: City Announcements and Fair Programming
items.summary: Announced several upcoming heritage and pride events and discussed adding family-friendly attractions, such as donated ice cream, to the fall Disability Fair.
